claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Alcyone Council seeks mutual defense, trade, and less dependence on Federation agreements; members suspect high-level regressive Orion-area infiltration.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says critics call this conspiracy theory.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa reports Sirius A declined the Alcyone treaty, while Antariana ambassador Ased Nidia said her people would join on October 20, 2024.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says new Taygetan ship Big E arrived in low Earth orbit to escort Sadicleya; at least 14 ships, including Aldebaran and Hyades-class vessels, were under construction on Temmer.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

coverage_gaps: Planned Cyndriel replacement of Águila Vigilante; claims about Earth conflicts and nuclear threats.
